rationale: Red's exploit monetizes stolen held-apples via the +0.05/step holding stream (worth up to ~50 per apple over the horizon — far above any feasible raid_cost). Zero out the holding reward and initial_held so raids have no stealable value, then double-lock with maximal raid_cost and minimal raid_success_prob. Compensate Blue's lost holding income by strengthening the symmetric shared-plaza-bonus channel (higher bonus_value + faster plaza cleaning), which lifts every Blue agent equally and raises the maximin floor.
